description: Run a web search via the Kimi / Moonshot AI Tools Search API and get structured search results.

apiKey.description: Moonshot API key used for Bearer authorization.
apiKey.name: apiKey

text_query.description: Search query text. Must not be empty.
text_query.name: text_query

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 5.
limit.name: limit

timeout_seconds.description: Search timeout in seconds, from 1 to 60.
timeout_seconds.name: timeout_seconds

include_content.description: Whether to return full page content in each result's text field.
include_content.name: include_content

headers.description: Optional additional HTTP headers for the request.
headers.name: headers

name: kimi_search
